title: Quotients of mosaics and related hyperstructures
summary: This is a thorough study of quotients of hyperstructures that generalize hypergroups, namely mosaics and semimosaics. The quotients in these categories generalize those studied previously in the literature on hypergroups. We describe the effective congruences in these categories by characterizing them in terms of their underlying equivalence relation. This characterization is applied to provide new methods of constructing quotient objects modulo the action of endomorphisms, as well as to study explicit quotient mosaics of some small groups.
